page.content:
Largest Broadway landlord, still named for the Shubert brothers.

How The Shubert Organization connects

  • Topic: Broadway — The Shubert Organization is Broadway's largest theatre landlord.
  • Location: Shubert Theatre — The Shubert Organization owns the Shubert Theatre.
  • Location: Majestic Theatre — The Majestic Theatre is a Shubert house.
  • Location: Winter Garden Theatre — The Winter Garden Theatre is a Shubert house.

What is The Shubert Organization?

The Shubert Organization owns and operates more Broadway theatres than anyone else, including the Shubert Theatre, and remains the landlord half of many long-run deals.

Key threads lead to Broadway, Shubert Theatre, Majestic Theatre and Winter Garden Theatre.
